title: A pcb document, as the engine answers it (PcbDrawing)

group.description: the group's name; empty when it is in none

default.description: Whether there is nothing to write: in no group, free.

Arrangement.description: How a drawn item stands among the others: the group it is chosen and moved with — empty for none —, and its own state. An item is held where it stands when it is locked itself or its group is (holds).

DrawnGroup.description: A group of a drawing as an item of its own: its name, by which its members say they are in it, and its state — a locked group holds every member where it stands, whatever each says of itself.

layer.description: the copper layer it is on

through.description: a point it bends through, between its ends

arrangement.description: the group it is chosen and moved with, and whether it is locked where it stands

finish.description: what its copper is left as: bare, the solder mask open along it; empty for under the mask

PcbDrawing.Arc.description: A track bent as an arc, through three points.

offset.description: how far its line is drawn aside of the two points, millimetres

PcbDrawing.Dimension.description: A measure drawn on the pcb: the distance between two points.

x.description: where it stands, millimetres from the left

ring.description: the copper ring's diameter round it, millimetres; 0: a bare hole

PcbDrawing.Hole.description: A hole drilled through the pcb that is no part's.

layers.description: the layers it keeps copper off

PcbDrawing.Keepout.description: An area where no copper is laid.

width.description: the width its tracks are laid at, millimetres

clearance.description: how far its copper stands from other nets', millimetres

drill.description: its vias' drill, millimetres; 0 with diameter: the pcb's usual via

diameter.description: its vias' copper ring across, millimetres; 0 for the pcb's usual via

PcbDrawing.NetClass.description: A class of nets, routed alike.

name.description: one word it is known by

formats.description: the formats, by the word each is written under: gerber, step

title.description: how a reader is shown it

PcbDrawing.Output.description: What this pcb is released as: a set of formats written together.

width.description: the width each of its tracks is laid at, millimetres

gap.description: how far apart its two tracks run, millimetres

skew.description: how far the two lengths may differ, millimetres; 0: the two lengths are not matched

PcbDrawing.Pair.description: A differential pair: two nets routed side by side.

designator.description: the part it places, as the circuit names it

x.description: where its origin stands, millimetres from the left

y.description: where its origin stands, millimetres down

rotation.description: how far it is turned, degrees counter-clockwise as the pcb is seen

reference.description: where its designator stands in the part's own frame; empty for where its footprint's field puts it

shown.description: what is printed for it where that is not its designator — R1 for S1_R1 —; empty for its designator

footprint.description: the footprint a part that is only the pcb's stands on — a mounting hole, a logo —; empty for a part of the circuit

nets.description: the pad a net stands on, by net — nets (GND = 1) —, for a part that is only the pcb's

arrangement.description: the group it is chosen and moved with, and whether it is locked where it stands

role.description: what it is to the copper beyond its pads: link for a 0 Ω link, its pads one piece of copper; empty for a part

PcbDrawing.Placement.description: Where a part stands on the pcb.

x.description: millimetres right of the part's origin

rotation.description: how far it is turned, degrees

layer.description: the layer it is printed on; empty for its footprint's field's

PcbDrawing.Reference.description: Where a part's designator stands in its own frame, and how it is turned.

profile.description: the maker's profile it starts from, by its word

changes.description: the values the pcb changes of its way of making, by rule word, in millimetres

PcbDrawing.Rules.description: How a pcb is made: its maker's profile, and what the pcb changes of it.

layer.description: the layer's id: top, inner-1, top-silkscreen, bottom-mask, comments

width.description: what it is stroked with; 0 when it is filled

filled.description: whether it is an area rather than lines

net.description: the net copper carries; empty for none

path.description: what it draws, as path data

PcbDrawing.Shape.description: Something drawn on a layer of the pcb itself, which no part brought: a logo on the silkscreen, a window in the mask, a note on the documentation, copper that is no track.

vias.description: the vias offered, each a drill with its copper ring

PcbDrawing.Sizes.description: The sizes a pcb offers new copper in, beside what its classes say: track widths, and via drills each with its diameter. Empty lists: the editor's own.

target.description: what the tracks enter: round pads and vias, surface pads, or other tracks

length.description: how far along the track a drop reaches, as a share of the copper it enters

width.description: how wide a drop's base is, as a share of the copper it enters

curved.description: whether a drop's sides are curved rather than straight

PcbDrawing.Teardrop.description: Where a pcb widens its tracks as they enter copper, and how far: a drop's measures are shares of the copper it enters.

x.description: where they stand, millimetres from the left

size.description: how tall their letters are, millimetres

rotation.description: how far they are turned, degrees

anchor.description: which part of the words stands on their point: start, middle — the usual — or end

layer.description: the copper layer it is on: top, inner-1 …, bottom

rounding.description: how far its corners are rounded, millimetres; 0 for sharp corners

points.description: the points it runs through, in order, at least two

arrangement.description: the group it is chosen and moved with, and whether it is locked where it stands

finish.description: what its copper is left as: bare, the solder mask open along it for solder to be run on; empty for under the mask

PcbDrawing.Track.description: A track: straight copper run through points on one layer.

x.description: where it stands, millimetres from the left

from.description: the layer it starts on; empty for through the pcb

to.description: the layer it ends on; empty for through the pcb

open.description: where the solder mask is left open over it: top, bottom or both; empty for covered

arrangement.description: the group it is chosen and moved with, and whether it is locked where it stands

PcbDrawing.Via.description: A via: a plated hole joining copper layers.

diameter.description: the copper ring's diameter around it

PcbDrawing.ViaSize.description: A via's drill and the copper ring's diameter around it, millimetres.

layer.description: the copper layer it is poured on

clearance.description: how far it stands from other nets' copper, millimetres; 0 for the pcb's own

priority.description: which pour is filled first where two claim an area: the higher; 0 for the lowest

path.description: the area it fills, as path data

finish.description: what its copper is left as: bare, the solder mask open over all of it; empty for under the mask

PcbDrawing.Zone.description: A copper pour: an area of a layer filled with one net's copper, round whatever else stands in it.

circuit.description: the slug of the circuit it lays out; empty for a pcb of no circuit

rules.description: how it is made — its maker's profile and what it changes of it —, where it says

netClasses.description: the classes its nets are routed by: each one's track width, clearance and via

sizes.description: the sizes it offers new copper in beside its classes'

teardrops.description: where its tracks are widened as they enter copper, and how far

pairs.description: its differential pairs: two nets routed side by side at one gap

copperLayers.description: how many copper layers it has; 0 when it does not say

outline.description: its edge, as path data; empty for a pcb with none drawn yet

placements.description: where each part stands on it

keepouts.description: the areas where copper is not laid

holes.description: the holes drilled through it that are no part's

shapes.description: what is drawn on its layers that no part brought

outputs.description: what it is released as, each a set of formats written together

groups.description: the groups its items are chosen and moved with, each with its own state; a group only named by its members is a free one

description: A pcb as data an editor works on — the circuit it lays out, how it is made, its copper layers and edge, where each part stands and the copper between them —, in millimetres, Y downwards. It is data; how it is sent is the product's.
